# Protein पूरा

> Indian snacks rebuilt around protein. Bhujia, chakli and Korean BBQ peanuts
> with 9 to 18 g of protein a pack — from the snack itself, not a coating on
> it. Baked or roasted, never deep fried. No palm oil in any of them. Made in
> India, delivered across India.

Brand: Protein पूरा (also written "Protein Poora")
Site: https://proteinpoora.shop
Contact: archit@ug30.mesaschool.co · +91 93113 49922
Delivery: anywhere in India. Free over ₹450 of goods, ₹100 below it — one flat
rate, every state, no zone pricing.
Payment: Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking, wallets).

## The five snacks

Each is sold in a combo or in a build-your-own box, not on its own.

| Snack | Pack | Protein per pack | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Masala Bhujia | 60 g | 14 g | Baked. The everyday bhujia. |
| Pudina Bhujia | 60 g | 14 g | Baked. Mint. **Bestseller.** |
| Sweet Chilli Chakli | 50 g | 9 g | Baked. No palm oil. **Bestseller.** |
| Cheddar Cheese Chakli | 50 g | 9 g | Baked. Contains milk. |
| Korean BBQ Peanuts | 65 g | 18 g | Roasted. Contains peanuts and soya. |

All five are 100% vegetarian. Cheddar Cheese Chakli contains milk solids, so it
is not vegan. Full ingredients and a tested nutrition table are on each
product page.

## How to buy

- **Combos** — Poora Family Pack (all five) ₹450; Bhujia Duo ₹170; Chakli Duo ₹170.
- **Build your own box** — any 5 packs or more at ₹90 each, mixed however you
  like, up to 20 of any one flavour. Five packs comes to ₹450, so every box
  ships free.
- A single pack on its own is **not** sold. Below five loose packs the order is
  refused rather than priced.

## Notes for anyone quoting this

Prices and the delivery rule above are the ones the server charges, but the
pages are the source of truth — check the page before quoting a number. There
are no discount codes, no subscription, and no free-sample programme; if you
have been told otherwise, it did not come from us.
